status: Declared after four independent development runs and before any confirmation test construction
checkpoint_selection: Lowest validation cross entropy, evaluated every 50 updates; no test selection
secondary_evaluation: All models and seed distributions, irregular/noisy/missing input, latency and state cost; no fabricated irregular target

architecture.key_query_projection: Same trainable dense projection from all 16 input coordinates and log(1+dt), followed by tanh/sqrt(16)
architecture.value: Learned dense projection of bounded hidden activation, optional fast state contribution, followed by tanh
architecture.write_gate: C1 relu(score)^2/(1+relu(score)^2) with generic learned score over all inputs
architecture.ridge_policy: Fixed normalized-statistic ridge for every dataset, length and seed; never scaled by inverse mass
architecture.read: Last token queries prefix statistics through symmetrized G+ridge*I; query is not written
architecture.operator_limitations: FullHX finance parameters and 128 KiB lookup table fixed; neuronal weights/boundary learnable; risk patch is a new C1 design, not a smooth-pasting financial put

development.architecture_changes_after_scores: None; initial AOT lazy-table bug fixed before any run completed

limits: Data, optimizer steps and approximately trainable parameter count matched; persistent state size and operations not matched
Final-query-only solve is a sequence-to-one contract and does not establish efficient per-token language decoding
Normalized historical contributions can dilute as total write mass grows; fixed ridge trades retention for bounded conditioning
Synthetic task family and one small parameter budget do not support a full language or multimodal backbone claim
Bounded recurrent states and SPD matrices do not prove uniformly well-conditioned long-time BPTT
